grammar.summary: 本课学习表"预设"的 premise 与 be committed to doing。

points.title: be committed to doing 表投身
points.explanation: He is committed to studying... commit 的 -ed 形容词 + to + V-ing：to 是介词。

examples.en: They are committed to their research.

points.title: 表"极端重要"的 of utmost importance
points.explanation: of + 抽象名词 = 形容词：of importance = important，of utmost importance = 极其重要。

examples.en: This question is of utmost importance.
